# BLISS Lab, Yonsei University — publication summaries (English)

Source: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/publications.html. Principal investigator: Jungmok Seo (서정목), School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Yonsei University.

## #102 Synergistic Mechano-Fluidic Self-Fusion of Poly(Vinyl Alcohol)-Modified Liquid-Metal Particles for Post-Treatment-Free Soft Electronics
- Authors: Keun-Young Yook, Sangwon Kim, Chansoo Kim, Minkyong Kang, Yurim Lee, Mido Kim, Kijun Park, Seung Yeop Han, Seung-Woo Cho, Gun-Hee Lee, Kayoung Son, Hanbit Jang, Tae Young Kim, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Advanced Science, e78062 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/advs.78062
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/advs-78062.html
- Theme: Stretchable conductors and interconnects
- Summary: PVA-modified liquid-metal particle ink that conducts as sprayed, giving 1.5 × 10^6 S m−1 without post-treatment and continuity beyond 200% strain.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text, Experimental Section and figure legends of the open-access article (PMC13643113). The supporting information, videos and source data were not reviewed.

## #101 Bridging IC chips and deformable circuits: A packaging framework for high-density soft electronics
- Authors: Yurim Lee, Yeontaek Lee, Siyeon Park, Hyein Ham, Hanbit Jang, Yunmin Jung, Sooin Lee, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Materials Science and Engineering R: Reports, 171, 101285 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mser.2026.101285
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/mser-2026-101285.html
- Theme: Device integration and packaging
- Summary: Review of packaging rigid IC chips into soft electronics across three architectures and three interface requirements; sub-100 μm fine pitch is the key barrier.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full main text, Tables 1–7 and figure captions of the published version, read from a local text copy of the ScienceDirect article. Figure images and the reference list were not reviewed, and device values are reported as summarized in the review.

## #100 Advances in Wearable Thermoelectric Devices: Strategies for Enhancing Wearability and Performance
- Authors: Yurim Lee, Hyein Ham, Siyeon Park, Hanbit Jang, Seungwan Hong, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Small Science, 6(9), e70402 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/smsc.70402
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/smsc-70402.html
- Theme: Device integration and packaging
- Summary: Review of wearable thermoelectric devices that links skin contact, stretchable design and heat-flow paths to performance; Table 4 spans up to 25.34 μW cm−2 K−2.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text, Tables 1–4 and figure legends of the open-access review (PMC13618461). Device values are reported as summarized in the review; the cited primary studies were not consulted.

## #99 Bioadhesive hydrogels as immunomodulatory interfaces for chronic wound healing: from microenvironmental regulation mechanism to engineering strategies
- Authors: Kayoung Son, Soo A Kim, Minkyong Kang, Yejin Jo, Chansoo Kim, Kijun Park, Yunmin Jung, Tae Young Kim, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Burns & Trauma, 14, tkag055 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1093/burnst/tkag055
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/burnst-tkag055.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: A review of bioadhesive hydrogels as immunomodulatory interfaces for chronic wounds, grouped into protective, bioactive, stimuli-responsive and sensing designs.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text and Table 1 of the open-access review (PMC13602266); Tables 2 to 4 were reviewed through their headings and the passages that cite them, and the cited primary studies were not read.

## #98 Play‐Doh Inspired a Transformative, Shape‐Adaptive iHEÄLS Enabling Post‐Crosslinking Mechanical‐Biological Modulation and Its Effectiveness in Musculoskeletal Repair
- Authors: Niyou Wang, Chao Liang, Soo A Kim, Jessica Heline Lopes da Fonseca, María José Veana Hernandez, Zahra Rezaei, Alvaro Dario Martinez Blanco, Nicole Joy Bassous, Da Seul Kim, Yejin Jo, Tae Young Kim, Yipei Yang, Ziqi Huang, Siyuan Chen, Feiming Li, Marcos Akira dAvila, June-Seo Kim, Misun Kang, Jungmok Seo, Sang Jin Lee, Su Ryon Shin
- Journal: Advanced Materials, e74385 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.74385
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/adma-74385.html
- Theme: Materials in contact with tissue
- Summary: A moldable PVA/gelatin/nanocellulose hydro-dough stopped calvarial sinus bleeding within 50 s and, with bone fragments, reached 34.80% BV/TV at 8 weeks.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the main text, figure legends and Methods sections 5.1 to 5.9 of the article on Wiley Online Library. Later Methods sections and the supplementary information were not reviewed; the liver hemostasis value follows the Results (about 78%), while the Discussion gives a reduction of over 65%.

## #97 Immune‐Responsive Bioinks Enable Vision‐Guided in Situ Robotic Bioprinting to Accelerate Diabetic Wound Healing
- Authors: Seol-Ha Jeong, Eleftheria-Angeliki Valsami, Ki-Tae Kim, Kijun Park, Jihyun Kim, Javier Alejandro Lozano Soto, Jaeseo Lee, Rafael Alejandro Cornejo Rodríguez, Danilo Martins dos Santos, Jarno Hiemstra, Mei L. L. Cham-Pérez, Montserrat Legorreta Gonzalez, Soo A Kim, Jungmok Seo, Zhuqing Li, Brendan Craig Thibault, Nebras Sobahi, Yejin Jo, Mohammad Asif Hussain, Kyungsang Kim, Lance Fiondella, Aristidis Veves, Woo-Jin Kim, Georgios Theocharidis, Su Ryon Shin
- Journal: Advanced Functional Materials, 36(67), e77191 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/adfm.77191
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/adfm-77191.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: An oxygen-releasing, hMSC-laden bioink printed into diabetic mouse wounds by a vision-guided robot accelerated wound closure relative to Tegaderm.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text, figure legends and parts of the Methods of the author manuscript on PubMed Central (PMC13668246). Supplementary figures, tables, videos and spatial-transcriptomic source data were not reviewed.

## #96 Lubricious anti-adhesive interface prevents friction, biofilm, and encrustation in long-term indwelling ureteral stents
- Authors: Yejin Jo, Yeontaek Lee, Sungun Bang, Kayoung Son, Kijun Park, Dokyun Kim, Soo A Kim, Seonghyeon Eom, Inhee Choi, Su-Jin Shin, Kyo Chul Koo, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Materials Today Bio, 39, 103405 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mtbio.2026.103405
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/mtbio-2026-103405.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: A ureteral stent whose microporous TPU wall stores silicone oil. Pull-out force was 0.07 ± 0.02 N, 7.9-fold lower than Polaris Ultra, without pre-hydration.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text and figure legends of the open-access article (PMC13355568); supplementary figures, tables and the supplementary movie were not reviewed.

## #95 Intelligent multimodal-energy-driven piezoelectric antibacterial platforms: From structural control to system-level diagnosis
- Authors: Jiaqi Liu, Jun Li, Huiyan Sun, Jungmok Seo, Yanmei Zhang, Yunlong Yu
- Journal: Materials Today Bio, 38, 103299 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mtbio.2026.103299
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/mtbio-2026-103299.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: Review of piezoelectric antibacterial platforms driven by multiple energy inputs and AI, covering mechanisms, material design, applications and reporting gaps.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text of the open-access review (PMC13253188), including its tables and figure legends; quantitative examples are reported as the review summarizes them, and the cited primary studies were not checked.

## #94 Disposable Endoscope Cap Maintaining Clear Surgical Visualization under Fogging and Fouling
- Authors: Kayoung Son, Yeontaek Lee, Kyungwon Lee, Yejin Jo, Yurim Lee, Seung Hyun Lee, Min Young Seo, Jung Seung Lee, Seung Ah Lee, Seung-No Hong, Seung Hoon Lee, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces, 18(25), 34821-34834 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1021/acsami.6c04312
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/acsami-6c04312.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: A single-use endoscope cap with a PDMS brush and silicone oil interface; one sponge refresh restored visual clarity from 84.3 ± 4.8% to 98.9 ± 1.2%.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full main text, methods and figure legends of the published article and the text of its supporting information (figure captions S1-S16 and Tables S1-S2); Supplementary Video 1 and values plotted only in figure panels were not reviewed.

## #93 Quinone-mediated, tissue-adaptive double-network hydrogel for instant hemostasis and wet-tissue adhesion
- Authors: Tae Young Kim, Kayoung Son, Chang-Hwan Moon, Keun-Young Yook, Soo A Kim, Hyein Ham, Yurim Lee, Soo In Lee, Yejin Jo, Yunlong Yu, Dae-Hyun Kim, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Nature Communications, 17, 5526 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-72068-6
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/s41467-026-72068-6.html
- Theme: Materials in contact with tissue
- Summary: STAT, a quinone-mediated double-network hydrogel, bonded to wet porcine skin at 273 kPa lap-shear strength and stopped mouse liver bleeding within 10 s.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text and figure legends of the open-access article (PMC13287715), the Supplementary Information figure legends and Supplementary Table 1, and selected Source Data sheets; values given as ranges are the individual data points in the Source Data. The supplementary movies, reporting summary and peer review file were not reviewed.

## #92 Slippery dopamine–fluoropolymer hybrid surface for improving biliary stent longevity
- Authors: Tae Young Kim, Won-Jong Lee, Yurim Lee, Seo Jung Kim, Sungjin Min, Seyong Chung, Soo A Kim, Keun-Young Yook, Chang-Hwan Moon, Yeontaek Lee, Kijun Park, Dae-Hyun Kim, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Bioactive Materials, 61, 210 - 228 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.bioactmat.2026.02.003
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/bioactmat-2026-02-003.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: ELFS, a polydopamine-anchored lubricant-infused stent coating, kept rabbit bile duct stents open for 2 months while uncoated stents became fully occluded.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text and figure legends of the open-access article (PMC12924897); the supplementary data, which include several of the cited supplementary figures, were not reviewed.

## #91 Ion‑Mediated Structural Engineering of Hydrogel Interfaces for Tunable Mechanical and Analyte Diffusion Properties in Electrochemical Biosensors
- Authors: Dongwook Lee, Soo A Kim, Beom‐Jun Shim, Yurim Lee, Tae Young Kim, Sunghyun Park, Yeontaek Lee, Hyeong Gyu Choi, Kayoung Son, Su Bin Han, Keun-Young Yook, Seo Jung Kim, Won-Yong Lee, Jungmok Seo, Jayoung Kim
- Journal: Advanced Materials, 38(19), e15767 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.202515767
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/adma-202515767.html
- Theme: Materials in contact with tissue
- Summary: Sulfate and calcium treatment order tuned PVA–alginate hydrogel pores from 65 nm to 2.5 µm, setting glucose sensor ranges for sweat and interstitial fluid.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text and figure legends of the open-access article (PMC13040517); the Supporting Information, which contains several of the cited supplementary figures and tables, was not reviewed.

## #90 Mechanically Robust and Anti‐Biofouling Hybrid Encapsulation via Layered Organic–Liquid Interfaces for Implantable Devices
- Authors: Sangwoo Park, Kijun Park, Tae Young Kim, Yejin Jo, Jangho Kim, Kayoung Son, Hayoung Choi, Myoung-Ryul Ok, Su Ryon Shin, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Small, 22(17), e10949 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/smll.202510949
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/smll-202510949.html
- Theme: Device integration and packaging
- Summary: A bonded silicone/Parylene C multilayer with an oil-infused surface gave 86-fold higher adhesion than Parylene C and 160-fold longer insulation life at 85 °C.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the main text, figure legends and Methods of the published version of record in Small (15 pages); the supporting information (Figures S1–S8) was not reviewed, and the derivation of the 445 h estimate at 37 °C was not found in the main text.

## #89 Optimized Electrical Stimulation Using a Spray‐Printed Conductive Electroceutical Patch for Accelerated Wound Healing in Diabetic Mice
- Authors: Jung Hyun Kim, Soo A Kim, Seung Hyun Lee, Young Min Jeon, Kijun Park, Minkyong Kang, Sangwon Kim, Tae Young Kim, Yeontaek Lee, Chun Gwon Park, Jungmok Seo, Jung Seung Lee
- Journal: Advanced Healthcare Materials, 15(12), e04939 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/adhm.202504939
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/adhm-202504939.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: A spray-printed PVA/liquid-metal patch delivered screened stimulation to diabetic mouse wounds, leaving 23.4% wound area at day 3 versus 66.8% untreated.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the main text, figure legends and Methods of the published CC BY 4.0 version of record (17 pages); the supporting information (Figures S1–S25) and source data were not reviewed.

## #88 Omniphobic Polymer/Graphene Oxide-Coated PVDF Membrane for Stable Membrane Distillation in Surfactant-Containing Seawater
- Authors: Jiwon Kim, Kwang-Duck Park, Jungmok Seo, Yun Chul Woo, Dae Woo Kim
- Journal: ACS Environmental Au, 6(1), 125-133 (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1021/acsenvironau.5c00199
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/acsenvironau-5c00199.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: A graphene oxide and perfluoropolyether coating on PVDF kept salt rejection above 99.7% at 15.4 LMH flux for 24 h of distillation with 0.4 mM surfactant.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text, figure captions and Table 1 of the open-access article retrieved from Europe PMC (PMC12828614); the supporting information was not reviewed.

## #87 A Remotely Actuated Multifunctional Nitinol–PMMA Smart Biocomposite: Microcellular Foaming, Shape Morphing, and Controlled Drug Release
- Authors: Donghwan Lim, Jaehoo Kim, Tae Young Kim, Jiwon Kwon, Jaewoo Kim, Jungmok Seo, Yong Hoon Jang, Sung Woon Cha, and Jun Young Yoon
- Journal: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces, 17(51), 70047 - 70058 (2025)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1021/acsami.5c19771
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/acsami-5c19771.html
- Theme: Device integration and packaging
- Summary: Nitinol–PMMA composite in which induction heating drives shape recovery and CO2 foaming; foaming raised impact strength by 142% and tuned model drug release.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text of the article on the publisher's site (Results and Discussion, Experimental Section, Table 1 and figure captions); the Supporting Information, which holds the CEM43 and lap-shear data, was not reviewed, and the impact strength gain is given as 143% in the abstract and 142% in the Results.

## #86 Encapsulation Strategies for OLEDs: From Conventional Devices to Flexible and Biointegrated Applications
- Authors: Jangho Kim, Sangwoo Park, Tae Young Kim, Yejin Jo, Kijun Park, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Advanced Electronic Materials, 11(19), e00475 (2025)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/aelm.202500475
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/aelm-202500475.html
- Theme: Device integration and packaging
- Summary: Review of OLED encapsulation from glass lids to thin-film hybrid multilayers, linking WVTR targets near 10−6 g m−2 day−1 to flexible and bioelectronic devices.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full HTML text of the open-access review (CC BY 4.0), Sections 1 to 6 and Tables 1 to 6. Figure captions were not displayed on the page and were not read, and the cited primary studies were not checked against their original reports.

## #85 Bioadaptive liquid-infused multifunctional fibers for long-term neural recording via BDNF stabilization and enhanced neural interaction
- Authors: Tae Young Kim, Yeonzu Son, Keun-Young Yook, Dong Gyu Lee, Young Kim, Seo Jung Kim, Kijun Park, Yurim Lee, Tae Kyung Lee, Justin J. Chung, Congqi Yang, Seongjun Park, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Science Advances, 11(37), eadz1228 (2025)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.adz1228
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/sciadv-adz1228.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: A lubricant-infused, BDNF-immobilized coating on flexible neural fibers cut insertion load from 25.2 to 2.94 mN and enabled 12-month recording in mice.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text, figure legends and Materials and Methods of the open-access article (PMC12422202); the supplementary materials were not reviewed. Quantitative values for in vitro cell coverage and protein attachment are taken from the Introduction, and most histological comparisons are reported as relative differences without numerical values in the main text.

## #84 Gas‐Specific and Tunable Hydrogen‐Selective ZIF Membrane through Combined Physical Confinement and Sealing Techniques
- Authors: Eunji Choi, Seungho Yu, Taehwan Kim, Yeontaek Lee, Hyungjoon Ji, Minsu Kim, Wooyoung Choi, Ju Yeon Kim, Yunseong Ji, Jungmok Seo, Kiwon Eum, Ki Chul Kim, Dae Woo Kim
- Journal: Small, 21(34), 2501590 (2025)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/smll.202501590
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/smll-202501590.html
- Theme: Device integration and packaging
- Summary: PFPE sealing of a nanoribbon-rigidified ZIF-8 membrane gave ideal H2/N2 selectivity of 209; added plasma fluorination raised ideal H2/CH4 selectivity to 1218.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text and figure legends of the open-access article (PMC12393018); the supporting information, including Tables S1–S5 and Figures S1–S13, was not reviewed, and the permeance units are reproduced as printed in the article (mol m−2·Pa·s).

## #83 Rapid and Scalable Lubrication Coating for Industrial and Medical Applications via Sequential Dip‐Coating
- Authors: Yeontaek Lee, Kayoung Son, Yejin Jo, Seung Hyun Lee, Jeuhee Lee, Tae Young Kim, Seonghyeon Eom, Youn-Hoo Hwang, Dae-Eun Kim, Inhee Choi, Jung Seung Lee, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Advanced Materials Interfaces, 12(14), e00353 (2025)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/admi.202500353
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/admi-202500353.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: A 10 s two-step perfluoropolyether dip coating gave 12 materials a ~110° contact angle, cut friction from 0.22 to 0.08 and reduced B. cereus attachment by 91.2%.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the main text, figure legends and Experimental Section of the open-access version of record in Advanced Materials Interfaces (12 pages); the supporting information and movies were not reviewed, and several summary figures in the Introduction and Conclusion (sliding angle, residue and blood-stain reductions) differ from the values in the Results, as noted in the text.

## #82 Large Scale Ultrafast Manufacturing of Wireless Soft Bioelectronics Enabled by Autonomous Robot Arm Printing Assisted by a Computer Vision‐Enabled Guidance System for Personalized Wound Healing
- Authors: Jihyun Kim, Seol-Ha Jeong, Brendan Craig Thibault, Javier Alejandro Lozano Soto, Hiroyuki Tetsuka, Surya Varchasvi Devaraj, Estefania Riestra de la Rosa, Yeongseok Jang, Jeong Wook Seo, Rafael Alejandro Cornejo Rodriguez, Lucia L. Huang, Yuhan Lee, Ioana Preda, Sameer Sonkusale, Lance Fiondella, Jungmok Seo, Lorenzo Pirrami, Su Ryon Shin
- Journal: Advanced Healthcare Materials, 14(1), 2401735 (2025)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/adhm.202401735
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/adhm-202401735.html
- Theme: Device integration and packaging
- Summary: A vision-guided 6-axis robot printer made wound-matched wireless stimulation patches; in vitro, stimulation sped fibroblast and endothelial cell migration.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the full text and figure legends of the NIH author manuscript in PMC (PMC11695167); the supporting information and movies were not reviewed, and the Methods describe the migration assay with different signal and timing values (about 10 Vpp at 4 Hz, 6 h) from those in the Results.

## #81 Lubricant‐Coated Organ‐on‐a‐Chip for Enhanced Precision in Preclinical Drug Testing
- Authors: Tae Young Kim, Jeong-Won Choi, Kijun Park, SeungHwan Kim, Jeong F. Kim, Tae-Eun Park, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Small, 20(43), 2402431 (2024)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/smll.202402431
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/smll-202402431.html
- Theme: Biological responses and surface design
- Summary: A lubricant-coated PDMS organ chip recovered 94.9% of dopamine and 98.6% of levodopa in cell-free tests, versus 83.2% and 89.6% in a conventional PDMS chip.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the published open-access PDF of the article, including the main text, figure legends and Experimental Section; the Supporting Information was not reviewed.

## #80 Universal hydrogel adhesives with robust chain entanglement for bridging soft electronic materials
- Authors: Yejin Jo, Yurim Lee, Jeong Hyun Heo, Yeonzu Son, Tae Young Kim, Kijun Park, Soye Kim, Seo Jung Kim, Yoonhee Jin, Seongjun Park, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: npj Flexible Electronics, 8, 39 (2024)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41528-024-00327-x
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/s41528-024-00327-x.html
- Theme: Device integration and packaging
- Summary: A sub-micrometre dried PVA/tannic acid multilayer adhesive bonded metals, polymers and hydrogels within 1 min and joined wearable and implantable soft devices.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the open-access article on the publisher's website (main text, figure legends and Methods), checked against the published PDF; the Supplementary Information and movies were not reviewed.

## #79 Hydrogel Ink for 3D Printing with High and Widely Tunable Mechanical Properties via the Salting‐Out Effect
- Authors: Kun Woo Ko, Taehoon Lee, Jae-Hak Jeong, Yeontaek Lee, Ikjin Kim, Jungmok Seo, Yong-Hwa Park, Jin-Oh Kim, Steve Park
- Journal: Advanced Materials Technologies, 9(10), 2400157 (2024)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/admt.202400157
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/admt-202400157.html
- Theme: Materials in contact with tissue
- Summary: A salting-out hydrogel ink kept gelation below room temperature for direct ink writing, yielding printed hydrogels with Young's moduli of 0.193–1.072 MPa.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the published PDF of the article, including the main text, figure legends and Experimental Section; the Supporting Information and movies were not reviewed.

## #78 Postoperative Long-Term Monitoring of Mechanical Characteristics in Reconstructed Soft Tissues Using Biocompatible, Immune-Tolerant, and Wireless Electronic Sutures
- Authors: Mugeun Lee, Yeontaek Lee, Ji Hye Choi, Hwajoong Kim, Daun Jeong, Kijun Park, Jinho Kim, Jae Park, Woo Young Jang, Jungmok Seo, Jaehong Lee
- Journal: ACS Nano, 18(19), 12210-12224 (2024)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1021/acsnano.4c00396
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/acsnano-4c00396.html
- Theme: Device integration and packaging
- Summary: A wireless, chip-less strain-sensing suture followed a reconstructed porcine Achilles tendon for 10 weeks; strain fell to 5.83% (normal tendon: 4.38%).
- Source scope: This summary is based on the main text, figure legends, Conclusions and Experimental Section of the published version of record (ACS Nano, 15-page PDF, local copy downloaded through Yonsei University). The Supporting Information, including the analytical models for strain and stiffness and Figures S1–S24, and Movies S1–S2 were not reviewed; values attributed to supporting figures are those stated in the main text.

## #77 Modulus-tunable multifunctional hydrogel ink with nanofillers for 3D-Printed soft electronics
- Authors: Minkyong Kang, Jae Park, Soo A Kim, Tae Young Kim, Ju Yeon Kim, Dae Woo Kim, Kijun Park, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Biosensors & Bioelectronics, 255, 116257 (2024)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.bios.2024.116257
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/bios-2024-116257.html
- Theme: Materials in contact with tissue
- Summary: Nanoclay and carbon nanotube fillers set a 3D-printable hydrogel ink to 10–300 kPa modulus and about 20 S/m conductivity for a ring-shaped finger sensor.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the main text, figure legends and Materials and methods of the published version of record (Biosensors and Bioelectronics, 13-page Elsevier PDF, local copy). The supplementary data (Figures S1–S28, Table S1 and Movies S1–S4) were not reviewed; values attributed to supplementary figures are those stated in the main text.

## #76 Autonomously Self‐healing, Adhesive, and Stretchable Triboelectric Nanogenerator Using Multifunctional Hydrogel‐Elastomer Double Layer with a Power Management Circuit
- Authors: Jinseok Oh, Minkyong Kang, Jae Park, Tae Young Kim, Kijun Park, Jungmok Seo
- Journal: Advanced Electronic Materials, 10(8), 2400013 (2024)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/aelm.202400013
- Summary page: https://bliss.yonsei.ac.kr/resources/en/papers/aelm-202400013.html
- Theme: Device integration and packaging
- Summary: A self-healing, adhesive hydrogel-Ecoflex triboelectric nanogenerator gave about 180 V and 0.8 μA, and a power management circuit charged capacitors to 5 V.
- Source scope: This summary is based on the main text, figure legends and Experimental Section of the published version of record (Advanced Electronic Materials, 11-page Wiley PDF, local copy). The Supporting Information (Figures S1–S22) and Videos S1–S2 were not reviewed; values attributed to supporting figures are those stated in the main text.

## #75 Intelligent In situ Printing of Multimaterial Bioinks for First‐Aid Wound Care Guided by Eye‐In‐Hand Robot Technology
- Authors: Seol-Ha Jeong, Jihyun Kim, Brendan Craig Thibault, Javier Alejandro Lozano Soto, Fatima Tourk, Joshua Steakelum, Diego Azuela, Violeta Carvalho, Guillermo Quiroga-Ocaña, Weida Zhuang, Mei Li L. Cham-Pérez, Lucia L. Huang, Zhuqing Li, Eleftheria‐Angeliki Valsami, Enya Wang, Nelson Rodrigues, Senhorinha F.C.F. Teixeira, Yuhan Lee, Jungmok Seo, Aristidis Veves, Shabir Hassan, Georgios Theocharidis, Lance Fiondella, Su Ryon Shin
- Journal: Advanced Materials Technologies, 9(11), 2400060 (2024)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/admt.202400060
